title: Communication Protocol No. 3-10 Write Capability Catalog

not_off_grid_mode.reason: This action is only valid outside Off-Grid mode.

capabilities.change_summary: Changes the inverter output topology mode reported by the Protocol No. 3-10 configuration block.
capabilities.note: Output mode at Protocol No. 3-10 register 600.

capabilities.change_summary: Changes how the inverter prioritizes PV, battery, and utility when powering the load.
capabilities.note: Output source priority at Protocol No. 3-10 register 601.

choices.label: PV-Utility-Battery
choices.description: Prefer PV first, then utility, then battery.

choices.label: PV-Battery-Utility
choices.description: Prefer PV first, then battery, then utility.

choices.label: PV-Utility-Battery (Grid-Tied PV)
choices.description: Prefer PV first with grid-tied PV behavior enabled.

capabilities.title: Secondary Output Priority
capabilities.support_notes: Protocol No. 3-10, the SmartESS field catalog, and a live register read agree on register 602 and values 0..3. Local write behavior still requires hardware retesting, so this control is available only in Full Control.
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the priority used by the inverter's secondary output.
capabilities.note: Secondary output priority at register 602. Read mapping is hardware-correlated; local writes are not yet hardware-confirmed.

capabilities.title: Secondary Output Priority Start Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes when the secondary output priority schedule starts.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 603, encoded as HHMM.

capabilities.title: Secondary Output Priority End Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes when the secondary output priority schedule ends.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 604, encoded as HHMM.

capabilities.title: OP2 Overload Alarm Setting
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the secondary output overload alarm threshold.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 608; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.

capabilities.title: OP2 Output Enabled
capabilities.change_summary: Controls whether the secondary output is allowed to operate.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 609; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.

capabilities.title: OP2 Output Start Hour
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the first hour in which OP2 may operate.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 610; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.

capabilities.title: OP2 Output End Hour
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the last hour in which OP2 may operate.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 611; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.

capabilities.title: Force Eq Charge
capabilities.change_summary: Starts one manual battery equalization cycle immediately.
capabilities.note: Write register 656 with value 1 to force one equalization charge cycle.

capabilities.title: Input Mode
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the AC input operating mode used by the inverter.
capabilities.note: Input mode at Protocol No. 3-10 register 677.
Buzzer mode at Protocol No. 3-10 register 678.
LCD backlight behavior at Protocol No. 3-10 register 679.
LCD auto-return behavior at Protocol No. 3-10 register 680.
Power-saving flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 681.
Overload restart flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 682.
Over-temperature restart flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 683.
Overload bypass flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 684.

capabilities.title: Warning Mask I
capabilities.change_summary: Changes which warning bits are allowed to appear on the inverter.
capabilities.note: Write registers 687..688 as a high-word-first unsigned 32-bit mask; bits set to 0 are blocked and bits set to 1 are shown normally.

capabilities.title: Dry Contact
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the operating mode of the dry-contact output.
capabilities.note: Dry-contact mode at Protocol No. 3-10 register 689.

capabilities.title: Automatic Mains Output
capabilities.change_summary: Controls whether AC output starts automatically when the power button is not pressed.
capabilities.note: Automatic mains-output flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 690.

choices.label: Manual Start Required
choices.description: Do not enable AC output automatically.

choices.label: Automatic Output Enabled
choices.description: Allow AC output to start automatically.

capabilities.note: Turn-on mode at Protocol No. 3-10 register 693.

capabilities.change_summary: Requests remote turn-on through Protocol No. 3-10 register 694.
capabilities.note: Write register 694 with value 1 to request remote turn-on.

capabilities.change_summary: Requests remote shutdown through Protocol No. 3-10 register 694.
capabilities.note: Write register 694 with value 0 to request remote shutdown.

capabilities.change_summary: Sends the inverter command that exits the fault lock state when supported by the current fault condition.
capabilities.note: Write register 695 with value 1 to request exit from the fault lock state.

capabilities.title: Inverter Date Write
capabilities.change_summary: Writes the inverter date registers from a YYYY-MM-DD value.
capabilities.note: Write registers 696..698 with year, month, and day values.

capabilities.title: Inverter Time Write
capabilities.change_summary: Writes the inverter time registers from an HH:MM:SS value.
capabilities.note: Write registers 699..701 with hour, minute, and second values.

capabilities.title: Ground Relay Enabled
capabilities.change_summary: Controls whether the ground relay is enabled.
capabilities.note: Ground-relay flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 707; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.

capabilities.title: Lithium Battery Activation Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the lithium battery activation time.
capabilities.note: Lithium battery activation time at Protocol No. 3-10 register 709.

capabilities.title: Lithium Battery Automatic Activation
capabilities.change_summary: Controls whether one lithium-battery activation is attempted automatically after power-on.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 858.

capabilities.title: Activate Lithium Battery Once
capabilities.change_summary: Requests one lithium-battery activation cycle.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 859. This is a write-triggered action and has no durable read-back value.

capabilities.title: Clear Generation Data
capabilities.support_notes: Catalogued from Protocol No. 3-10 but blocked from runtime execution until an exact model validates the irreversible operation.
capabilities.change_summary: Clears the inverter's stored generation counters.
capabilities.note: Write register 705 with value 0xAA to clear all generation data.

capabilities.title: Reset User Parameters
capabilities.support_notes: Catalogued from Protocol No. 3-10 but blocked from runtime execution until an exact model validates the destructive reset semantics.
capabilities.change_summary: Restores user parameters to their defaults when the inverter is not in Off-Grid mode.
capabilities.note: Write register 706 with value 0xAA to reset user parameters to their defaults.

capabilities.title: Battery Type
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the battery chemistry profile.
capabilities.note: Battery type at Protocol No. 3-10 register 630.
Battery equalization flag at Protocol No. 3-10 register 651.

capabilities.title: OP1 Off-Grid Low Voltage Protection
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the OP1 battery low-voltage protection threshold in off-grid mode.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 645; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.
Battery discharge SOC protection threshold at Protocol No. 3-10 register 647.
Battery discharge SOC recovery threshold at Protocol No. 3-10 register 648.
Off-grid battery discharge SOC protection threshold at Protocol No. 3-10 register 650.
Charge source priority at Protocol No. 3-10 register 632.

choices.label: PV Priority
choices.description: Prefer PV charging when solar power is available.

choices.label: PV and Utility
choices.description: Allow both PV and utility charging.

choices.label: PV Priority With Load Reserve
choices.description: Prefer PV charging while reserving PV for the load when needed.

capabilities.title: Secondary Charging Priority
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the secondary charging priority used by the inverter.
capabilities.note: Secondary charging priority at Protocol No. 3-10 register 633.

capabilities.title: Secondary Charging Priority Start Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes when the secondary charging priority schedule starts.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 634, encoded as HHMM.

capabilities.title: Secondary Charging Priority End Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes when the secondary charging priority schedule ends.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 635, encoded as HHMM.

capabilities.title: Constant Voltage To Float Wait Time
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the wait time before switching from constant-voltage charging to float charging.
capabilities.note: Constant-voltage to float wait time at Protocol No. 3-10 register 639.

capabilities.title: Maximum Discharge Current Protection
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the maximum discharge current protection threshold.
capabilities.note: Maximum discharge current protection at Protocol No. 3-10 register 642.

capabilities.title: OP1 Off-Grid SOC Protection
capabilities.change_summary: Changes the OP1 SOC protection threshold used in off-grid mode.
capabilities.note: Protocol No. 3-10 register 649; valid only for protocol 4 and 6.
